description: Fictional, independently written operational conversations across six domains. Questions and full-turn evidence labels stay outside the search index.

sessions.title: East gallery climate
sessions.question: Set the east gallery humidity ceiling.
sessions.answer: The east gallery humidity ceiling is 50 percent. This is a provisional setting pending the conservator's inspection.

sessions.title: East gallery climate
sessions.question: Update the east gallery humidity ceiling.
sessions.answer: The east gallery humidity ceiling is now 42 percent after inspection. The previous 50 percent ceiling is withdrawn; the display cases remain closed during adjustment.

sessions.title: Unpacking loans
sessions.question: What happens after the loan crates arrive?
sessions.answer: Leave loan crates sealed in the receiving room for 24 hours before unpacking. Record the arrival time on the paper log; a courier signature alone does not start an early opening exception.

sessions.title: Supporting brass artifacts
sessions.question: Which mounting method is approved?
sessions.answer: Secure brass artifact mounts with padded clamps attached to the plinth. Adhesive tape must not touch the artifact because removal can lift the surface patina.

sessions.title: Reading in the dim room
sessions.question: Visitors struggle with the small captions in low light.
sessions.answer: Offer a large-print booklet at the gallery entrance. Do not increase illumination near the dyed textiles; the booklet contains the same captions in a more legible format.

sessions.title: Desk routing
sessions.question: Which intake code should the desk use?
sessions.answer: Use intake code MUSE-17 for objects awaiting condition review. Educational replicas go to the teaching cabinet and must not enter this queue.

sessions.title: Loan crate labels
sessions.question: How are loan crates labelled after unpacking?
sessions.answer: Retain the lender's crate labels and photograph each empty crate. Store the label images with the loan agreement; these photographs document packaging and do not replace object condition photographs.

sessions.title: 北坡灌溉计划
sessions.question: 北坡的灌溉间隔定多少？
sessions.answer: 北坡暂定每隔三天灌溉一次，先执行到土壤检测完成。每次开始前检查滴头有没有堵塞。

sessions.title: 北坡灌溉计划
sessions.question: 北坡灌溉间隔调整结果是什么？
sessions.answer: 土壤检测后，北坡改为每隔五天灌溉一次，替代原来的三天间隔；遇到明显降雨时当次暂停，不能补浇两轮。

sessions.title: 梨果采收
sessions.question: 梨果什么时候采收？
sessions.answer: 梨果在清晨露水干后采收，装入浅筐时只放两层。不要把落地果混进当天发货的筐里。

sessions.title: 冷库接收
sessions.question: 采收后的梨果如何入冷库？
sessions.answer: 采收后的梨果先在阴凉棚散热两小时，再送入四摄氏度冷库。入库时给每筐贴上采收地块和日期，不要堵住风道。

sessions.title: 花期作业安排
sessions.question: 花期喷药有哪些限制？
sessions.answer: 花期白天停止喷药，把必要作业安排在蜜蜂归巢后的傍晚。这样可减少授粉昆虫直接接触药液。

sessions.title: Desk routing
sessions.question: Which intake code should the desk use?
sessions.answer: Use intake code ORCH-62 for field samples awaiting the orchard soil test. Fruit quality samples go into the harvest register instead.

sessions.title: 浅筐清洁
sessions.question: 梨果浅筐怎样清洗？
sessions.answer: 梨果浅筐每天收工后用清水冲洗并倒置晾干。筐底破损的直接移出采收区，不允许贴胶带后继续装果。

sessions.title: Evening company call
sessions.question: When is the evening company call?
sessions.answer: The evening company call is provisionally 18:00. Wardrobe will use the first ten minutes for microphone belt checks.

sessions.title: Evening company call
sessions.question: Confirm the revised evening company call.
sessions.answer: The evening company call moves to 17:40 to allow the lift rehearsal. This replaces the provisional 18:00 time, while microphone belt checks still happen first.

sessions.title: Scene change cue
sessions.question: What triggers the blackout for the scene change?
sessions.answer: The blackout follows the third bell from the stage manager. The lighting operator must wait for that bell even if the actors have already left the platform.

sessions.title: Platform interlock
sessions.question: When may the platform lift move?
sessions.answer: The platform lift may move only after both side gates report closed. A missing gate indicator requires a manual stop; a verbal assurance does not override the interlock.

sessions.title: Audience accommodation
sessions.question: Some patrons find sudden loud effects overwhelming.
sessions.answer: The Saturday matinee uses reduced sound peaks and keeps a quiet room open beside the foyer. Patrons may leave and return through the side door during that performance.

sessions.title: Desk routing
sessions.question: Which intake code should the desk use?
sessions.answer: Use intake code STAGE-28 for props awaiting a safety inspection. Costume alterations are recorded by wardrobe rather than the props desk.

sessions.title: Bell inventory
sessions.question: Where are the scene-change bells stored?
sessions.answer: The scene-change bells are kept in the locked prompt cabinet after rehearsal. The spare bell is labelled green and must be returned before the next company arrives.

sessions.title: 画册裁切
sessions.question: 画册出血尺寸暂定多少？
sessions.answer: 画册出血暂定两毫米，排版人员先按这个尺寸检查图片是否覆盖到页边。印前确认后再锁定最终文件。

sessions.title: 画册裁切
sessions.question: 画册出血尺寸最终确认了吗？
sessions.answer: 画册出血最终改为三毫米，旧的两毫米设置不再使用。所有跨页图片重新检查，裁切线外不要放页码和署名。

sessions.title: 色样签字
sessions.question: 彩色封面开印前需要什么确认？
sessions.answer: 彩色封面开印前必须拿到客户签字的纸质色样。屏幕截图只能用于讨论构图，不能替代色样签字。

sessions.title: 胶装等待
sessions.question: 胶装后的成品多久能装箱？
sessions.answer: 胶装完成后平放十二小时再装箱，让书脊胶层充分稳定。等待期间不要把样书完全压平翻阅。

sessions.title: 折页方向
sessions.question: 内页纸纹应该朝哪个方向？
sessions.answer: 内页纸纹应平行于书脊，否则翻阅时页面不易摊开，折线也更容易开裂。裁纸之前先在边角料上做折叠检查。

sessions.title: Desk routing
sessions.question: Which intake code should the desk use?
sessions.answer: Use intake code PRINT-43 for files awaiting prepress checks. Replacement toner requests belong in the supplies ledger and must not block the print queue.

sessions.title: 装箱清单
sessions.question: 画册装箱清单写什么？
sessions.answer: 画册装箱清单记录箱号、册数和印次。每箱放一张清单副本，整批出货再附一张总表。

sessions.title: Comet exposure plan
sessions.question: Set the comet exposure duration.
sessions.answer: The provisional comet exposure duration is 45 seconds. Use the guide camera for the entire sequence and retain the first frame for inspection.

sessions.title: Comet exposure plan
sessions.question: What is the revised comet exposure duration?
sessions.answer: The comet exposure duration is now 20 seconds to reduce trailing. This supersedes the 45-second plan; keep the guide camera running throughout the sequence.

sessions.title: Flat-field calibration
sessions.question: When should the flat-field frames be captured?
sessions.answer: Capture flat-field frames at dusk with the same filter and camera rotation as the science frames. Rotating the camera afterward requires a new set of flats.

sessions.title: Focus check schedule
sessions.question: How often should focus be checked?
sessions.answer: Recheck focus whenever the air temperature changes by two degrees Celsius. Log the focuser position with the temperature so a shift can be distinguished from poor seeing.

sessions.title: Night vision at the telescope
sessions.question: How should observers illuminate their notes?
sessions.answer: Use a dim red torch for paper notes and cover white status lights. This preserves dark adaptation for observers looking through the eyepiece.

sessions.title: Desk routing
sessions.question: Which intake code should the desk use?
sessions.answer: Use intake code SKY-91 for detector frames awaiting calibration. Visitor photographs stay in the outreach archive and are not mixed with science frames.

sessions.title: Filter storage
sessions.question: How do filters return to storage?
sessions.answer: Return each filter to its numbered sleeve after the observing run. Record any surface marks before closing the cabinet; cleaning requires the optical technician's approval.

sessions.title: 周末领取时段
sessions.question: 周末领取最晚几点结束？
sessions.answer: 周末领取暂定下午四点结束。结束前先清点未领取的预约袋，避免把已预约的物资当作剩余库存。

sessions.title: 周末领取时段
sessions.question: 周末领取结束时间变了吗？
sessions.answer: 周末领取现在延长到下午五点，替代原来的四点结束安排。预约袋仍需保留到该时段结束再清点。

sessions.title: 捐赠面包分拣
sessions.question: 捐赠面包如何分拣？
sessions.answer: 捐赠面包按含坚果与不含坚果分开放置，并保留原包装上的配料表。包装破损而无法确认配料的批次暂停分发。

sessions.title: 独居老人配送
sessions.question: 给独居老人配送时有哪些交接要求？
sessions.answer: 配送员到达后先敲门确认收件人在家，再把物资交到本人手中。无人应门时带回站点并登记，不把袋子留在门口。

sessions.title: 领取登记方式
sessions.question: 怎样填写领取登记？
sessions.answer: 领取登记只填写预约编号和袋数，公开排队名单不展示姓名。需要联系时由值班负责人查看单独保存的联系方式。

sessions.title: Desk routing
sessions.question: Which intake code should the desk use?
sessions.answer: Use intake code FOOD-35 for donations awaiting sorting. Volunteer travel reimbursements are handled in the accounts folder rather than the donation queue.

sessions.title: 面包货架整理
sessions.question: 面包货架多久整理一次？
sessions.answer: 面包货架每个发放时段结束后整理一次。把空周转箱收回库房，保留尚未发放批次的标签直到当日盘点完成。
